answer: The payout waits in a vault that opens only when three island stamps arrive together. A claim's work passes through a prism that refracts it into a spectrum, each band ferried to an island where strangers re-perform that slice before stamping it. Clones from one operator refract into the identical spectrum, so islands comparing stamps void every match and burn the bonds. Each extra clone needs a fresh spectrum, fresh work, and each island's toll doubles per spectrum from the same trail, so n clones pay n spectra at doubling tolls for one vault share while one honest agent pays once.
